    Freight Sales- job post

    FreePL
    Cairo

    Job details

    Job type

    • Full-time
    &nbsp;

    Location

    Cairo
    &nbsp;

    Full job description

    Job Purpose

    Identifying and approaching prospective clients, understanding their shipping and logistics requirements, and developing competitive solutions that meet their operation's needs.

    Key Responsibilities

    • Identify and prospect potential customers across target industries and market segments.
    • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of new business opportunities through cold calling, networking, referrals, market research, and field visits.
    • Develop relationships with key decision-makers within prospective and existing accounts.
    • Convert qualified opportunities into active customers and consistently work toward monthly and quarterly sales targets.
    • Understand customer requirements across air freight, sea freight, land transportation, and other logistics services, depending on the company's service portfolio.
    • Prepare and present commercial proposals to prospective clients.
    • Regularly follow up with clients to understand upcoming shipment requirements and business opportunities.
    • Support the resolution of commercial or service-related issues to maintain customer satisfaction and retention.
    • Maintain accurate records of leads, client interactions, quotations, opportunities, and sales activities in the CRM or internal tracking system.
    • Provide regular sales pipeline, activity, and performance updates to management.

    Qualifications &Experience

    • Bachelor's degree in business administration, Logistics, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field.
    • 2-4 years of B2B sales or business development experience within freight forwarding, shipping, logistics, transportation, or supply chain services.
    • Good understanding of the freight forwarding and logistics industry.
    • Experience generating leads, approaching new clients, and managing the full sales cycle.
    • Target-driven and comfortable working toward revenue and new business objectives.
    • Strong follow-up, organization, and pipeline management skills.
    • Proficiency in using CRM systems.

    Core Competencies

    • New Business Development
    • Prospecting &Lead Generation
    • Consultative Selling
    • Negotiation &Closing
    • Relationship Management
    • Commercial Awareness
    • Customer Orientation
    • Results &Target Orientation
    • Market Intelligence
    • Cross-functional Collaboration
